name: Docling Serve
description: Document conversion as an API: send PDFs, Office files, HTML or images and get back Markdown, JSON or HTML with layout, tables and OCR text, ready for search indexes and language models. The CPU image carries its models, so nothing is downloaded at start; it is large (about 6 GB on disk).

access.note: Docling Serve is an API, not a page: programs call /v1/convert/source or /v1/convert/file with the generated DOCLING_SERVE_API_KEY from the Variables tab in an X-Api-Key header. Its own web UI is off because it would not ask for the key. Converting a URL fetches it from this server, so hand the key only to programs you trust.

inputs.name: domain

inputs.description: Optional; the address programs call; nothing else here changes when it does.
